description: Abnormal price moves that MoveSurge detected first and then investigated, each with the cause it found, the evidence, a confidence level and how the move followed through. Use for 'why did oil / the Nasdaq / a stock suddenly move' when no single headline explains it. Only moves whose cause was established with medium or high confidence are published.

asset.description: Restrict to one instrument symbol, e.g. WTI or NQ.

end_utc.description: Exclusive end timestamp with timezone. Overrides the relative look-back window.

hours.description: Look back 1-1440 hours; default 72. Older results are historical investigations.

start_utc.description: Inclusive start timestamp with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-14T00:00:00-04:00.

name: explained_moves
title: Explained price moves
